title: Getting to Know Plants

standard_text: Plants around us: trees, shrubs, herbs and climbers; parts of a plant and their work; parts of plants that we eat; what plants need to grow; caring for plants (summary of NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 4).
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 3 EVS worksheets for NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 4: trees, shrubs, herbs and climbers, parts of a plant, the parts we eat, and what plants need to grow. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Plants have roots, stems, leaves, flowers, fruits and seeds.
key_sub: Plants need sunlight, water, air and soil.
body_html:
How to think about it

Plants can be big trees like the mango and neem, bushy shrubs like the rose and tulsi, small herbs like mint and grass, or climbers like the money plant. Each part has a job: roots hold the plant and take in water, the stem holds it up, leaves make food using sunlight, and flowers make fruits and seeds.

We eat different parts of plants: carrots are roots, potatoes are stems, spinach is leaves, cauliflower is flowers, mangoes are fruits and peas are seeds. Plants need sunlight, water, air and soil to grow.

Example

Which part is a carrot?

it grows down into the soil

Answer: the root

Example

Which part makes food?

green and flat

Answer: the leaf

Common mistakes

  • Thinking a potato is a root.
  • Thinking plants need no sunlight.
  • Calling a tall rose bush a tree.
